description: A global 1km solar photovoltaic raster dataset is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Florian Zabel (University of Basel). This dataset is based on Kruitwagen, L., Story, K.T., Friedrich, J. et al. (2021): A global inventory of photovoltaic solar energy generating units. Nature 598, 604–610 (2021). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-021-03957-7 and the corresponding dataset (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.5005868). Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
